crest_rebuild.why: K-020: crest_entries tried only three screened speeds, and crest_ride refused the slowest soaring one in some seas; the speeds are now searched (crest_entries)

settings.dsopt: solve(mode max_speed along the course (soaring, folded_prop True) else min_power with motor and v_travel_min 0.5 v_best_ld, cycle travel, n 40, wave {a: Hs/2, wavelength: g Tp^2/2pi, to_deg}, wave_preset, tip_model geometric, midpoints, rate_limits pb2v, n_min 0, phase_pin theta, m_search (-1, 0, 1), replay_check, refine, seeds [0, 1, 2], stop_after 1, maxiter 150, profile_for(max(u10, 0.1), log, coare35))
settings.crest: steady flight in the wave frame on the forward face (crest_ride): along-crest ground speeds from -30 to 30 m/s in 0.5 m/s steps, folded propeller, wings level, no thrust, the phase of the largest surplus at h_min raised to the balance height (at most 10 m); kept: the slowest along-crest speed that soars and the fastest either way
settings.frame: wind toward +x, angles ccw from +x; z is the height above the LOCAL surface, z_abs above mean sea level, theta the wave phase at the aircraft; thrust in N per node
settings.cut: the optimizer's cycles are solved only for the seas of the first 1 tier(s); the other seas have crest rides only (a slot costs about 30 to 230 s of one core)
